note: Oct. 8 night draft, built Oct. 8-9, 2026. Forward air order. Punk and post-punk focus starts this show (config/show_focus.json): Clash and UK 1977 arc, CBGB closing 20 years ago on the show date, Sex Pistols at the Warfield Oct. 14. Friday sweep Oct. 9 added 7 bench tracks (Welcome to Earth is a swap candidate for Basic Witch, which Stace deleted from Weekly Oct. 9). Air Order unchanged. Oct. 9 update: Friday sweep (separate run) added 24 tracks to Weekly and logged Stace's deletes; Basic Witch replaced by IDLES Colossus. Oct. 15 morning: Air Order edits applied, tail tracks placed in sets, Kraftwerk and Cabaret Voltaire added for Fujiya & Miyagi.

opening: Punk and post-punk focus starts tonight: UK 1977 first, Texas punk next week, Halloween post-punk Oct. 29, D.C. hardcore Nov. 5.
Sex Pistols signed to EMI Oct. 8, 1976 (50 years). The reunion lineup (Steve Jones, Paul Cook, Glen Matlock, Frank Carter) was booked at the Warfield last night, Oct. 14.
after_uk_set: The Clash single Complete Control: fall 1977. Stiff Little Fingers released Alternative Ulster Oct. 17, 1978.
The Damned New Rose turns 50 next Thursday, Oct. 22. Held for that show.
after_cbgb_set: CBGB closed Oct. 15, 2006. Patti Smith played the last night, a three-hour set that ran past 1 a.m.
Bad Brains played the club's final week (I Against I is from 1986). Death Cab's The Photo Album turns 25 (Oct. 9, 2001). JSBX Now I Got Worry turns 30 today (Oct. 15, 1996, Matador).
end_hour_1: New this month: Julia Jacklin (The Gem, Sept. 25), BODEGA (All Inside Aquarium, Chrysalis), Sampa the Great (Location, third single from Nu Zamrock, Oct. 30, Loma Vista). Twisted Teens, Stalks, earlier this hour: The Holy Cross Tigers is out Nov. 6 on Sub Pop.
Station ID at the top of the hour.
after_triple_shot: Fontaines D.C. album Dopamine Chamber is out tomorrow on XL. Tour starts Oct. 21 in Lisbon.

The Cuckoo Is A-Callin' is the B-side of Too Real, the band's first 7-inch on Partisan (late 2018; sources give Nov. 12 and Dec. 14). Chequeless Reckless is from the 2018 single with Boys in the Better Land.
Tongue (shit x10) is not airable and sits in FCC Edit Needed.
bay_area_break: Boy Harsher at the Fox in Oakland and Imperial Teen at Bottom of the Hill tonight.
Heavens to Betsy first release since 1994 (baby's gone, Kill Rock Stars, Oct. 16). Bottom of the Hill Oct. 17 and 18.
Dinosaur Jr. with Stef Chura at the Castro Oct. 18 (sold out). Giveaway: Dinosaur Jr. at the Guild in Menlo Park Mon. Oct. 19. Confirm with Suzi.
after_songwriters_set: Sluice, Beadie: opener of Companion (Mtn Laurel Recording Co., Mar. 27). MJ Lenderman, She's Leaving You, from Manning Fireworks (2024).
Cameron Winter, Live at Carnegie Hall: recorded at a December 2025 show, out Oct. 9 on Partisan. SAULT, Wildfires, from 2020.
after_machines_set: Kraftwerk, Numbers, from Computer World (1981). Cabaret Voltaire, Nag, Nag, Nag, a 1979 single from Sheffield.
Fujiya & Miyagi, No Green Light, from New Shiny Object (Oct. 30). Stace's pairing: the Brighton band reads as Kraftwerk and Cabaret Voltaire.
